messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a quick, step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and for a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a thorough cleaning (strings, fretboard, body). Tune it to standard pitch. | A well‑presented instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Capture the front, back, sides, headstock, strings, and any imperfections. Use natural light and a neutral background. | Good photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of returns. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local classifieds. Note prices for similar models, ages, and conditions. | Helps you set a realistic asking price and avoid over‑ or under‑pricing. | | **4. Write a Detailed Description** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, condition notes, any upgrades, and why you’re selling. | Transparency builds trust and reduces negotiation friction. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments.
• **eBay** – broad audience, auction or fixed price.
• **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Local Music Stores** – some accept consignment or direct sales.
• **Specialty Forums** – e.g., Acoustic Guitar Forum, Gearslutz. | Different platforms reach different buyer types; listing on multiple can increase exposure. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target price if you’re using an auction format; set a firm price if you’re using “Buy It Now.” | Gives you room to negotiate while still aiming for your goal. | | **7. Decide on Shipping vs. Local Pickup** | • **Shipping**: Use a sturdy case, bubble wrap, and a reputable carrier (UPS, FedEx, USPS). Offer tracking and insurance.
• **Local Pickup**: Meet in a safe, public place (coffee shop, police station parking lot). Bring a friend if possible. | Shipping expands your buyer pool but adds cost; local pickup saves money but limits reach. | | **8. Handle Payment Securely** | • **Online**: PayPal Goods & Services, Venmo (with caution), or bank transfer.
• **In‑person**: Cash or certified check. Verify before handing over the guitar. | Protects both parties from fraud. | | **9. Prepare for Negotiation** | Be ready to answer questions about the guitar’s history, maintenance, and any issues. Have a minimum acceptable price in mind. | Smooth negotiations lead to quicker sales. | | **10. Close the Sale** | Once payment is confirmed, ship or hand over the guitar. Send a receipt or confirmation email. | Keeps records for tax purposes and ensures buyer satisfaction. | ### Quick Tips - **Timing**: Spring and summer are peak times for instrument sales (students returning to school, festivals). - **Safety**: If meeting locally, choose a well‑lit, public area and bring a friend or family member. - **Documentation**: Keep a copy of the sale agreement and any receipts for future reference. - **Return Policy**: Consider offering a short return window (e.g., 48 hrs) if the buyer is uncertain—this can boost confidence. ### Example Listing (Reverb) ``` Title: 2005 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition Description: - Brand: Yamaha - Model: FG800 - Year: 2005 - Serial: 12345678 - Condition: Minor scratches on the back, no cracks, fully functional - Features: Solid spruce top, nato/okume back & sides, 25.5" scale - Upgrades: New strings (D’Addario EJ16), new bridge pins - Reason for sale: Upgrading to a larger instrument Price: $350 (fixed) Photos: [Attach 8 high‑resolution images] Shipping: Will ship via UPS with insurance. Local pickup available in Seattle. Payment: PayPal Goods & Services Contact: [Your email] or message on Reverb ``` Feel free to adapt this template to your own guitar’s specifics. Good luck with your sale!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice on selling an acoustic guitar. We can provide steps: research market value, clean it, take photos, list on platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb, local music stores), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips. Also mention potential appraisal, trade-in, etc. Provide a concise guide. No function call needed.
